author: Inside Edition
description: The mother of a bride was left battered and bruised after she took a spill, landing on her face. Anne Golden McGinn was rushed to the emergency room. The mom's importance to the wedding is an understatement; Anne was supposed to walk daughter Cordelia down the aisle. Her husband, Bill McGinn, was a New York City firefighter who lost his life on 9/11 when Cordelia was 6. After Anne's fall, it was up to makeup artist Monica Cacciola to perform a miracle.
title: Makeup Artist Comes To Rescue After Mother Of Bride Falls Before Wedding

author: Inside Edition
description: Things did not go as planned in the execution of Christa Pike. The convicted murderer was to be the first woman put to death in Tennessee in more than 200 years. Two lethal injections of pentobarbital were administered to Pike on Wednesday, but she did not die. Pike's lawyers had argued a month ago that her veins were difficult to access. Inside Edition spoke to Dr. Joel Zivot, an expert on lethal-injection procedures who worked with Pike's legal team.
title: What Went Wrong In Christa Pike's Failed Execution?

author: Inside Edition
description: There were terrifying moments on a school bus, when it started to roll away as students were getting off. It happened in Pennsylvania. The school released video of how the students handled the scary situation. Officials say that when the high school students realized their driver was experiencing a medical emergency, they remained calm and worked as a team to prevent a disaster. One student engaged the parking brake, while another applied the foot brake. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: High School Students Step In To Stop Bus When Driver Has Medical Emergency
